levels.surface: يزيد بن خالد بن يزيد بن عبد الله بن موهب الرملي الهمداني

notes: Yazid and Abd al-Aziz meet at Muhammad b. Salama («قالا حدثنا»); Musa and Hammad are the third branch («ح»); the names after «حماد» are written once and belong to every route.
«- وهذا حديث محمد بن سلمة -» is an editor's gloss, left out.
Abu Dawud's remark that Yazid and Abd al-Aziz name Abu Umama b. Sahl with Abu Salama is a variant group, not a route.
